# OctaDezx

> OctaDezx is an agentic AI company. Its platform gives any business, of any kind, an always-on AI agent that does not merely reply but takes actions on the business's behalf: it answers questions, places orders, books appointments, answers and makes phone calls, reads photos customers send, follows up on leads and escalates to a person when it should. It works across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, Shopify and a website chat widget, in 50+ languages.

OctaDezx is not an e-commerce tool. It is used by restaurants, clinics, salons, law and accountancy practices, real estate agencies, schools, repair shops, hotels, logistics companies, SaaS products, agencies and retailers, as well as online stores. The dashboard itself adapts to the business type: a restaurant gets menus and reservations, a clinic gets appointments, a workshop gets jobs and quotes, a shop gets orders and shipments. Businesses with no product catalogue at all are a normal case, not an edge case.

The distinction that matters is agent versus chatbot. A chatbot returns text. An OctaDezx agent completes the task: it confirms and files the order with the price verified server-side against the business's own catalogue, takes the appointment and files the booking, transcribes and files the call, and creates the lead. It is trained on the business's own information, answers only from that real information, and hands over to a human with full conversation context when it cannot help.

## Key facts

- Company type: agentic AI company. The product is an AI agent that performs actions in the business's systems, not a chatbot that only produces replies
- Product type: AI customer service / customer care agent (SaaS, web-based)
- Business types: every kind of business, not only e-commerce. Retail and online stores, restaurants and cafes, clinics and healthcare, salons and beauty, law, accountancy and consulting practices, real estate agencies, schools and education, repair and trade services, automotive, hotels and travel, logistics and couriers, banks and finance, SaaS and software, marketing agencies, and enterprise teams. Solo founders through to enterprise
- Image recognition (vision): customers can send a PHOTO instead of describing what they want. The AI looks at the image, describes what it sees, matches it against the business's own catalogue, and replies with the matching product, its price and its details. When the business does not sell the item in the photo, the AI says so plainly and suggests the closest thing it does have. Typical uses: a shopper photographing a product they saw elsewhere, a customer photographing a damaged or faulty item, a diner photographing a dish, a client photographing a part, a document or a room. Images are fetched behind an SSRF guard, capped at 8MB and restricted to real image types
- Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, Discord, Slack, LINE, Viber, WeChat, X, a website chat widget and a shareable chat link, plus inbound and outbound phone calls; 90+ integrations in total including stores, CRMs, helpdesks, payment providers and 60+ couriers. Full directory at https://octadezx.com/integrations
- Voice (every paid plan): the AI answers a real phone number in real time, callers can interrupt it mid-sentence, it transfers to a human or takes a transcribed voicemail when it cannot help, and it can place outbound calls such as appointment reminders. Every call is stored as a plain-text transcript in the same history as chats. Voice notes on WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and Telegram are transcribed and answered in the same thread
- Actions during a phone call: the voice assistant books appointments and takes orders while still on the line, not just answers questions. It collects the details, reads them back for confirmation, and files the booking or order into the same dashboard as chat-taken ones before the call ends. Orders are restricted to products in the business's own catalogue
- Voice persona and training: owners give the assistant a name, job title and manner, and write plain-English instructions for how it should behave. Instructions for inbound calls and outbound calls are configured separately, and each individual outbound call can carry its own reason for calling. Owners also control whether the assistant states that it is automated and whether outbound calls offer a spoken opt-out
- Languages: 50+, auto-detected per customer
- Setup time: under 10 minutes: paste a storefront URL to import a product catalogue (works with Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix and any public catalogue), add policies/FAQs, connect a channel
- Order handling: the AI confirms and places orders; prices are verified server-side
- Escalation: conversations that need a human are handed off with full context
- Leads & follow-ups: customers who share contact details become leads automatically; owners write a plain-language follow-up playbook the AI applies in every conversation, and can send one-click follow-up messages into the customer's existing chat thread
- AI phone calls: every paid plan includes a real phone number the AI agent answers in real time. It is a spoken conversation, not a phone menu: the caller can interrupt it mid-sentence and it stops and listens. It answers from the same catalogue, prices, policies and opening hours as the chat, takes orders and appointment requests on the call and files them for the owner to confirm, hands over to a person or takes a transcribed voicemail when it cannot help, and writes every call into the same conversation history as the chats. It also calls out: appointment reminders and follow-ups on a schedule, each opening with a spoken opt-out. It never claims to be human. Included minutes: Starter 100 a month, Pro 400, Advanced 900, Enterprise metered at $0.12 a minute
- Claude / MCP integration: OctaDezx ships a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://octadezx.com/mcp. Connect Claude (claude.ai connectors or Claude Code) via OAuth to list escalated chats, read conversations, reply to customers, check orders, update products and add knowledge-base entries in plain language
- Analytics: resolution rate, response time, orders, revenue and CSAT in a live dashboard
- Actions the agent can complete on its own: place an order with server-verified pricing, take an appointment booking and file it, answer an inbound phone call, place an outbound phone call, transcribe and file a voicemail, read and act on a photo a customer sends, reply to a Facebook or Instagram comment, capture a lead and follow it up, and escalate to a human with the full conversation attached
- Dashboard adapts to the business type: a restaurant gets menus and reservations, a clinic gets appointments, a workshop gets jobs and quotes, a shop gets orders and shipments. Owners choose which features they want switched on
- Security: end-to-end encryption, role-based access, GDPR-ready
- Uptime: 99.9% SLA

## Pricing (USD, monthly or yearly; yearly billing gives 2 months free)

- Free trial: 24 hours, full access, no credit card required
- Starter: $29/month or $290/year: 2,500 AI messages a month, 100 phone minutes a month, 3 team seats, every channel and every feature, email support
- Pro: $99/month or $990/year: 10,000 AI messages a month, 400 phone minutes a month, 10 team seats, 10 calls answered at once, priority support
- Advanced: $199/month or $1,990/year: 22,000 AI messages a month, 900 phone minutes a month, 20 team seats, 25 calls answered at once, dedicated support channel
- Enterprise: pay as you go: $0.006 per AI message and $0.12 per phone minute, billed monthly on actual use with no cap on either meter, from $499 a month, 100 team seats, named success manager and uptime SLA

Every plan includes every feature. Volume, team seats and support are the only things that change between them. A message means one answer the AI sends, on any channel; phone minutes cover calls in and out.
- All plans are self-serve with instant checkout, no sales calls required

## Company

- OctaDezx is built and backed by Zeriotic (https://zeriotic.com), a web development studio that designs and builds storefronts, web apps and product experiences.
- Both teams are owned by DezxCorp, the holding company behind Zeriotic and OctaDezx. It sets one shared roadmap and engineering standard and holds the product for the long term.
- Hiring: two open remote roles, a Client Acquisition Executive (finds and closes new OctaDezx accounts, paid on uncapped recurring commission) and a Growth Marketer (owns content, SEO, paid and lifecycle, measured on activated accounts). Applications are submitted at https://octadezx.com/careers
- Affiliate programme: 30% recurring commission on every payment for as long as the referred customer stays subscribed, a 60-day cookie window, a 10% discount code for the partner's audience, monthly payouts above $50, and cash bonuses at 10, 25 and 50 active accounts. Applications at https://octadezx.com/affiliates

## Common questions

- What is OctaDezx? An agentic AI platform that gives any business an always-on AI agent for customer support and sales, which completes tasks rather than only answering.
- Is OctaDezx only for e-commerce? No. It is built for every kind of business. Restaurants, clinics, salons, professional practices, real estate agencies, schools, trades, hotels, logistics, SaaS and agencies all use it, and the dashboard changes to suit the business type. A catalogue is optional, not required.
- Can it see images? Yes. A customer can send a photo instead of describing what they need. The AI reads the photo, matches it against the business's own catalogue and answers with the product, price and details, or says honestly that the business does not stock it.
- Can it replace a human agent? It resolves routine support and product questions instantly, 24/7, and escalates complex conversations to the human team with full context.
- Does it take orders? Yes: it confirms and places orders with server-verified pricing, not just answers questions.
- Can it follow up with customers and leads? Yes: captured leads appear in the dashboard, the AI applies the owner's follow-up playbook in conversations, and owners can send one-click follow-ups into existing chat threads.
- Does it work with Claude? Yes: a native MCP server (octadezx.com/mcp) lets business owners manage chats, orders, products and knowledge from inside Claude, secured with OAuth.
- How fast can a business go live? Under 10 minutes, no developers required.
